metadataRaw.title: Standing Lower Back Self Pop 💥 #Shorts
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows the standing corkscrew exercise. 

This mobility exercise is a 'back opener' that can reduce tightness and stiffness, and may end with a satisfying self pop, crack, or release in the lower back.

It can be done at home, requires no equipment, and may give lower back pain relief within seconds.

Let us know how it works for you!
